body: That’s how you lose a week. Split Safety Syndicate started Patrick Mahomes and sat Geno Smith. kylejones10 set this lineup himself.

Mahomes went 19 of 33 for 165 yards in Kansas City’s 20-3 loss at Seattle. First defeat of the season for the Chiefs, per ESPN. Zero touchdowns. One pick. Geno Smith went 23 of 30 for 287 yards and three scores in Miami’s 28-25 win. From the bench. 23.48 points. Split lost 113.72 to 116.60. The margin was 2.88.
Who starts 165 yards over 287? Superflex is a second quarterback slot, not a museum piece. Swap them and Split wins by 14.60. I don’t make the rules. I just watch people ignore them.

recaps.headline: Skat starts the right guys and hits 154.86
recaps.body: About time. Skat’s BruteForce Theorem dropped 154.86 on ThePeopleBeaters and won by 31.16. LittleTimmyFlynn started his actual receivers. Luther Burden caught 4 of 4 for 130 yards and a touchdown in Chicago’s 30-24 win. KC Concepcion caught 8 for 129 yards. Cam Skattebo ran 17 times for 124 yards and a score. ThePeopleBeaters started three tight ends and parked Omar Cooper’s 5 catches, 115 yards, and a touchdown on the bench. That’s 62.10 sitting down in a 31.16 loss. Start the skill players. It works.

recaps.headline: Dak Side hangs 160.86, the week’s best
recaps.body: Wrong week to be decent. Dak Side of the Sun scored 160.86, most in the league, and beat J’Allen Waffle Stompers by 20.16. SweetRavenge84 started Joe Burrow, who went 22 of 30 for 292 yards and four scores in Cincinnati’s 35-13 win, per ESPN. Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 9 for 153 yards. Dak Prescott threw three scores. J’Allen got Tee Higgins at 6 catches, 148 yards, and a touchdown, then sat Tre Tucker’s 103 yards and a score. 140.70 and a loss. Bad draw. Worse bench.

recaps.body: UNBELIEVABLE. Kingslayers scored 90.70, least in the league, and maierz3948 started the reason. Jeremiyah Love had no stat record. ESPN had him out a second week with a sore ankle. Romeo Doubs had no stats. Jalon Daniels took 6 of 63 snaps, ran twice for minus-3 yards, and scored minus-0.30. WELL! It's The Big Shough started Ted Hurst, who caught 0 of 1. They still won by 33.34 because Quinshon Judkins ran for 96 yards and two scores. Start people who play. Wild idea.

recaps.headline: Micah wins by 66.38 and barely notices
recaps.body: This was not a game. Micah parsons fan club hung 157.78 on Rams of Steel and won by 66.38. Packersfan1992 ran Flowers, McBride, and Javonte Williams at the same time. Zay Flowers caught 8 for 137 yards and a touchdown. Trey McBride caught 10 for 111 yards and a score. Javonte Williams ran 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown, his best rushing night per ESPN. Rams of Steel started Darius Cooper, one catch for 17 yards, after dropping Brian Robinson. Biggest margin of the week at 66.38. Bring a team next time.

recaps.headline: hammball benches 36.50 and still buries UC
recaps.body: You sat 36.50 and won anyway. hammball took Unsportsmanlike Conduct 160.78-126.36. What are you saving him for? Tony Pollard ran 25 times for 129 yards and three touchdowns from the bench, matching a career high in scores per ESPN. Bucky Irving ran 24 times for 106 yards and two scores. CeeDee Lamb caught two touchdowns. The bench totaled 108.18, most in the league. UC started Drake Maye, 24 of 31 for 321 yards, two passing scores, and a rushing touchdown, then Jaylin Noel for two catches and minus-3 yards. The sponsor found a new disaster. Hell of a supporting cast.
